_meta.title: HyperEdit Upscale (video2x CLI)
_meta.description: video2x CLI wrapper config for AI upscaling and frame interpolation. NOT a ComfyUI workflow — invoke as CLI. Used by the FOOTAGE INTAKE agent (pre-assembly, upscale low-res clips) or post-assembly enhancement.

template_vars.INPUT_PATH: Absolute path to input video file
template_vars.OUTPUT_PATH: Absolute path for upscaled output video
template_vars.UPSCALER: real-esrgan | cugan (default: real-esrgan — best for real estate video)
template_vars.NOISE_LEVEL: Noise reduction level 0-3 for cugan, or denoise strength for real-esrgan (default: 0)
template_vars.INTERPOLATE_FPS: Target FPS for frame interpolation via RIFE (set to 0 to skip, e.g. 60 to double 30fps footage)

upscale_preset.command: video2x -i INPUT_PATH -o OUTPUT_PATH -w SCALE_FACTOR -h SCALE_FACTOR --upscaler real-esrgan

upscale_and_interpolate_preset.command: video2x -i INPUT_PATH -o OUTPUT_PATH -w SCALE_FACTOR -h SCALE_FACTOR --upscaler real-esrgan --interpolator rife --interpolate-fps INTERPOLATE_FPS

agent_usage.footage_intake: Run upscale_preset on low-res clips BEFORE assembly to normalize resolution.
agent_usage.post_assembly: Run upscale_and_interpolate_preset on picture_lock output for final quality enhancement.
agent_usage.output_naming: Append _upscaled or _4k to output filename prefix.
